name: flauz-release
description: Flauz install/update verification + the release checklist -- the beta gate's closing wave (A-PROD-004-W5): the verify plane (flauz.release.verify: the installed product state end-to-end -- the extension census with every packaged extension present + activation-lint clean, the packaging-parity contract rows vs manifests, the SBOM component coverage, the durable-state surfaces readable via the W1 census machinery, and the integrity verdicts with the W2 machinery applied to the CURRENT state -- a fresh self-export verifies; the typed verdict table green/tampered/torn per check class, the record persisted workspace-locally + census-visible), the pre-update gate (flauz.release.updateCheck: censuses the current state, reads the per-surface format versions, reports the migration readiness identity/transform/refusal via the W3 plan grammar + the anchor dry-run via the W2 machinery -- NEVER performs the update; the migration stays in flauz-migration's hands), and the one-command go/no-go (flauz.release.checklist: binds ALL TEN beta capabilities -- diagnostics census, backup/export, crash recovery, migration safety, telemetry opt-in state, failure typing, rollback anchor, support/debug bundle, install verification, and the checklist artifact itself -- every row with its evidence pointer, GO only when all ten are green, the artifact persisted + re-readable as the beta gate's closure evidence).
